title: Iterative tensor network transformations for element-wise evaluation of elementary and filtering functions
abstract: arXiv:2608.17135v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tensor networks are powerful formats for compressing large-scale data. However, their application to general data processing has been limited by the difficulty of performing nonlinear operations. Here, we introduce iterative tensor network transformations (ITNTs), a general algorithmic framework for the element-wise evaluation of elementary and nonlinear filtering functions on data encoded as tensor trains (TTs), a class of tensor networks. Our approach operates entirely in the compressed domain, enabling efficient computation on exponentially large datasets while maintaining a controlled computational cost. We demonstrate its power in two key areas: (I) evaluating highly nonlinear elementary and filtering functions on a 3D reactive flow field, enabling high-fidelity reaction rate computation and region filtering, and (II) finding extrema in complex optimization problems, such as solving Max-SAT instances on spaces up to $2^{70}$ confi

translated_title: 迭代张量网络变换用于初等函数与滤波函数的逐元素评估
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17135v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：张量网络是压缩大规模数据的强大格式。然而，由于非线性操作的困难，它们在一般数据处理中的应用受到限制。在此，我们引入迭代张量网络变换（ITNTs），这是一种通用算法框架，用于对以张量序列（TTs）编码的数据进行初等函数和非线性滤波函数的逐元素评估，其中张量序列是一类张量网络。我们的方法完全在压缩域中运行，使得在指数级大数据集上实现高效计算成为可能，同时保持可控的计算成本。我们在两个关键领域展示了其能力：（I）在三维反应流场上评估高度非线性的初等函数和滤波函数，实现高保真反应速率计算和区域滤波；（II）在复杂优化问题中寻找极值，例如在高达$2^{70}$个配置的空间上求解Max-SAT实例。
tldr: 本文提出了一种全新的迭代张量网络变换（ITNTs）算法框架，能在压缩域中对张量序列编码的数据高效执行非线性函数和滤波操作，从而突破张量网络在非线性处理上的瓶颈，并成功应用于高维反应流场计算和超大空间优化问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces iterative tensor network transformations (ITNTs), a novel algorithmic framework that efficiently performs nonlinear element-wise functions and filtering on tensor-train encoded data entirely in the compressed domain, overcoming previous limitations and enabling applications in high-dimensional reactive flow computations and large-scale optimization.
